courses.title: The Members Club for the Mind
courses.description: Maude's online membership, begun in lockdown, with a weekly-updated library of recorded meditation, breathwork and yoga classes and, at the premium level, a live weekly group check-in. It is pitched at easing anxiety, sleeping better and building self-confidence.

courses.title: EnergyRise app
courses.description: Maude's own meditation app for iPhone and iPad, with ten-minute guided meditations for different moods and short personal articles, meant to make a daily practice easy to keep on the go.
courses.price: Free to download; EnergyRise Pro £7.99 monthly or £59.99 annual

left_out: Meditation for ADHD (maudehirst.co.uk/meditation-for-adhd, £25): presents meditation as ADHD support that 'minimises impulsivity' and links an ADHD supplement brand; a treatment framing for a medical condition (new health rule).
Back to School Anxiety Toolkit: no page found on her site (not in its sitemap).
